title: US dollar dips as oil eases, yen jumps on Japan remarks

background.headline: Trump rejects Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal for Hormuz as Saudi coalition intercepts projectiles
background.summary: CNBC reported, citing the Wall Street Journal, that President Trump rejected Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal tied to the Strait of Hormuz, while a Saudi-led coalition intercepted incoming projectiles, keeping Middle East war-risk elevated heading into the weekend.
background.summary_ja: CNBCがウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルの報道として伝えたところによると、トランプ大統領はホルムズ海峡を巡るイランの条件付き停戦案を拒否し、サウジ主導の連合軍は飛来物を迎撃した。週末を前に中東の地政学リスクは高止まりした。

background.headline: Katayama and Takaichi remarks send yen to best day in two weeks near 157/dollar as oil eases 2% on Iran truce hopes
background.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Tokyo "won't hesitate to take bold action" on the yen and Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said she had told President Trump an undervalued yen was "problematic," sending the yen up as much as 0.6-1% to around 157 per dollar for its best day in over two weeks, while the dollar dipped and oil eased roughly 2% on hopes for a US-Iran truce.
background.summary_ja: 片山さつき財務相が円について「大胆な行動を取ることも辞さない」と述べ、高市早苗首相もトランプ大統領に「円安は問題だ」と伝えたと明かしたことで、円は対ドルで一時0.6~1%上昇し1ドル=157円前後まで買われ、2週間超ぶりの大幅高となった。同日、ドルは下落し、米イラン停戦への期待から原油も約2%下落した。

background.headline: Katayama says principles behind July's Japan-US joint yen intervention 'remain alive'
background.summary: Katayama said the principles underpinning July's coordinated Japan-US yen-buying intervention "remain alive," signalling Tokyo's readiness to intervene jointly again if renewed yen weakness warrants it.
background.summary_ja: 片山財務相は7月の日米協調円買い介入を支える原則は「生きている」と述べ、円安が再燃すれば再び協調介入も辞さない姿勢を示した。

background.headline: BOJ hikes policy rate 25bp to 1.25%, highest since 1995, in split 7-2 vote
background.summary: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25% in a 7-2 vote at its September meeting, the highest level since 1995, with two reflationist board members appointed by PM Takaichi dissenting.
background.summary_ja: 日銀は9月の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を0.25%引き上げ1.25%とすることを7対2の賛成多数で決定した。1995年以来の高水準で、高市首相が任命したリフレ派の審議委員2人が反対した。

background.headline: Fed raises rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, first hike since 2023, dot plot flags more increases
background.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to a 3.75%-4.00% range, its first hike since 2023, with the updated dot plot signalling further increases could follow.
background.summary_ja: 米連邦準備制度理事会(FRB)はフェデラルファンド金利を0.25%引き上げ3.75~4.00%のレンジとした。2023年以来の利上げで、更新されたドットプロットは追加利上げの可能性を示唆した。

background.headline: OPEC+ core members hold October output flat after September's 188,000 bpd increase
background.summary: OPEC+'s core eight members agreed to hold October production at September's level, pausing further increases after having raised output by 188,000 barrels per day in September.
background.summary_ja: OPECプラスの主要8カ国は10月の生産量を9月と同水準に据え置くことで合意した。9月に日量18万8000バレルの増産を実施した後、増産ペースを一旦停止する形となった。

background.headline: Japan, US confirm rare July 31 coordinated yen-buying intervention, Bessent vows readiness for more
background.summary: Japan and the US confirmed a rare coordinated yen-buying intervention conducted on July 31, with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent saying Washington "will not hesitate to participate in further joint intervention" if disorderly currency moves resume.
background.summary_ja: 日本と米国は7月31日に実施した異例の協調円買い介入を確認した。ベッセント米財務長官は、無秩序な相場変動が再発すれば「さらなる協調介入への参加もためらわない」と述べた。

background.headline: BOJ holds rate at 1%, warns on inflation, same day as Japan-US joint yen intervention
background.summary: The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1% while warning that core inflation could exceed its 2% target, the same day Tokyo and Washington carried out their joint yen-buying intervention.
background.summary_ja: 日銀は政策金利を1%に据え置く一方、コアインフレ率が2%目標を上回る可能性があると警告した。同日、日米は協調円買い介入を実施した。

since.headline: Katayama repeats warning that undervalued yen is 'problematic' after phone call with Bessent
since.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the yen's undervaluation remains a concern and that Tokyo and Washington will stay in close contact to keep currency markets orderly, following her phone call with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
since.summary_ja: 片山さつき財務相は、円安は引き続き問題だとの認識を示し、外国為替市場の秩序維持へ日米で緊密な連絡を続ける考えを示した。ベッセント米財務長官との電話協議を受けた発言である。

since.headline: Iran's Araghchi meets Qatari mediators in New York, says US may respond to Hormuz proposal by Tuesday
since.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators in New York to relay Iran's amended Strait of Hormuz reopening proposal, saying he hoped for Washington's final response by Tuesday, while a US official said there would be no end-of-war agreement unless Iran's nuclear programme is addressed.
since.summary_ja: イランのアラグチ外相はニューヨークでカタール仲介団と会談し、ホルムズ海峡再開に関する修正提案を伝え、火曜日までに米国から最終回答を得たいとの見通しを示した。米当局者は、イランの核開発計画への対応なしに終戦合意はないと述べた。

since.headline: US officials say Hormuz oil flows near prewar levels despite Iran's claims of successful strikes
since.summary: US officials said oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have recovered substantially despite Iran's claims of successful attacks on shipping there, with the Energy Secretary citing about 13 million barrels a day and the Treasury Secretary citing an estimate of 15-22 million barrels a day, against roughly 20 million barrels a day before the war.
since.summary_ja: イランが同海峡付近での船舶攻撃の成功を主張する一方、米当局者はホルムズ海峡の原油輸送量が開戦前の水準に近づいていると述べた。米エネルギー長官は日量約1300万バレル、米財務長官は日量1500万~2200万バレルとの見方を示し、開戦前の日量約2000万バレルと比較した。

since.headline: Iran's army vows to keep blocking vessels near the Strait of Hormuz as Tehran says it is "fully prepared" for war
since.summary: An Iranian army deputy coordinator said Iranian forces are acting with authority in the northern Arabian Sea and east of the Strait of Hormuz and "will not let anyone pass," while Tehran said it remains open to "real diplomacy" but is fully prepared for war.
since.summary_ja: イラン軍副調整官は、イラン軍がアラビア海北部およびホルムズ海峡東方で権限を行使しており「誰も通過させない」と述べた。テヘラン側は「本物の外交」には引き続き前向きだとしつつ、戦争への備えは万全だとした。

since.headline: Dollar index climbs to around 101.15, on track for best month since June, as yen slips to 157.7 and Brent holds above $106
since.summary: The dollar index edged up to about 101.15, on track for a 1.7% gain in September, its best month since June, as the yen weakened 0.3% to 157.7 per dollar and Brent crude held above $106 a barrel, with hawkish Federal Reserve rate-hike bets and the US-Iran Hormuz standoff both supporting the dollar.
since.summary_ja: ドル指数は101.15程度まで上昇し、9月は1.7%高と6月以来最も良い月間成績となる見通しとなった。円は0.3%安の1ドル=157.7円まで下落し、ブレント原油は106ドル超を維持した。FRBの利上げ観測強まりと米イラン間のホルムズ海峡を巡る対立の双方がドルを支えた。

since.headline: Brent rebounds above $106, up over 1%, after Trump rejects Iran's Hormuz reopening proposal
since.summary: Brent crude rose more than 1%, back above $106 a barrel, after President Trump rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, reviving concern that restoration of oil flows through the waterway would be delayed.
since.summary_ja: トランプ大統領がホルムズ海峡再開を巡るイランの提案を拒否したことを受け、ブレント原油は1%超上昇し1バレル106ドル台を回復した。同海峡経由の原油輸送再開の遅れへの懸念が再燃した。

since.headline: Yen extends Friday's rally into thin Monday Asia trade as fresh Hormuz missile report sharpens risk
since.summary: The yen extended Friday's gains into thin Monday Asia trading, with risk sentiment further sharpened by a report from Iranian media of a missile fired at a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz.
since.summary_ja: 円は金曜日の上昇分を維持し、薄商いとなった月曜アジア時間も堅調に推移した。イラン国営メディアがホルムズ海峡での船舶へのミサイル発射を報じたことで、リスク心理は一段と敏感になった。

since.headline: Trump tells Axios he expects US-Iran talks to resume this week despite rejecting Tehran's truce plan
since.summary: Trump told Axios he expects US-Iran talks to resume this week, even as he rejected Iran's seven-day truce proposal tied to reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
since.summary_ja: トランプ氏はAxiosに対し、ホルムズ海峡再開を条件とするイランの7日間停戦案は拒否したものの、今週中に米イラン協議が再開する見通しだと語った。

since.headline: Iranian FM Araghchi says Tehran is ready for a "doomsday" war with the US but keeps diplomacy open
since.summary: In an interview aired Sunday, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran is prepared for a "doomsday" war with the United States after Trump rejected Tehran's seven-day Hormuz reopening proposal, while stressing Iran will not miss any chance for peace.
since.summary_ja: 日曜に放送されたインタビューで、イランのアラグチ外相は、トランプ大統領がテヘラン側のホルムズ海峡再開に向けた7日間停戦案を拒否したことを受け、米国との「終末的な」戦争に備えていると述べた一方、和平の機会は逃さない考えを強調した。
